title: Tenant-scoped RBAC with evented evidence stream for residency & retention audits
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem:
Customers in regulated industries require per-tenant access controls plus an auditable, residency-aware evidence trail for periodic access reviews. Today we have coarse org-wide roles and manual export workflows that are error-prone and frequently require engineering support.

Goals:
- Implement tenant-scoped RBAC that supports role inheritance and least-privilege mappings for hosted, dedicated, and private deployments.
- Automate SCIM provisioning and SSO/SAML role-to-group mapping for standard IdPs (Okta, Azure AD, OneLogin).
- Produce a tamper-evident event stream of access decisions, role changes, and SCIM/SSO provisioning events that is residency-tagged and exportable for audits.
- Surface retention policies per-region and per-customer, with automated evidence exports for periodic access reviews and compliance attestations.

Non-goals:
- Replacing existing IAM provider integrations (we continue to support current SSO flows).
- Full policy language (we will support a scoped role model; policy engine improvements are separate).

Acceptance criteria:
1) API: New tenant RBAC API supports create/read/update/delete roles with explicit "scope" attribute (tenant/global) and a migration API to map legacy org roles.
2) Provisioning: SCIM connector templates per IdP with attribute mapping docs; successful end-to-end tests with Okta and Azure AD test tenants.
3) Evidence stream: All access changes, role assignments, SSO logins (successful and failed), SCIM deltas, and admin role grants are emitted to an event stream (Kafka topic + durable S3/GCS-backed archive) with fields: timestamp, tenant_id, user_id, action, actor_id, region_tag, retention_policy_id, signed_sha256.
4) Retention: Console UI exposes retention buckets (90/365/custom) that apply to evidence exports and are enforced when exporting; customers can pin region (e.g., eu-west-1) to keep evidence within data residency constraints.
5) Automation: A nightly evidence export job packages a reviewer bundle for a tenant (csv+ndjson + signed manifest) and uploads to the customer-designated residency bucket or provides time-limited download links.
6) Rollout: Canary for two existing enterprise customers with dedicated capacity; migration scripts to translate 95% of legacy role assignments without manual edits.

Technical approach:
- RBAC model: Implement tenant-scoped Role entity (role.scope = "tenant"|"org") and RoleBinding that references principals (users, groups, service-principals). Keep current role names but attach scope metadata for compatibility.
- Provisioning: Extend existing SCIM worker to persist provenance events and map IdP groups -> tenant RoleBindings. Add claim-based role mapping in SAML/OIDC layer.
- Evidence stream: Produce events into an append-only Kafka topic per-region. A connector job writes compact ndjson segments to residency-bound object storage. Each segment includes a signed manifest (HMAC with multi-region key material) to provide tamper evidence.
- Schema: Use a stable event schema v1.0; include region_tag and retention_policy_id so export tooling can enforce residency and lifecycle.
- Storage & retention enforcement: Use lifecycle policies on cloud buckets and a retention ledger keyed by retention_policy_id to prevent premature deletion. For Private deployments, provide a tenant-local exporter that writes to a customer-managed bucket or local archive.

Migration plan:
- Step 1: Read-only migration run to estimate mapping coverage against existing roles (run in sandbox).
- Step 2: Provide dry-run migration tool for admins to preview changes.
- Step 3: Run upgrade with opt-in window; notify tenant admins via Console and email.
- Step 4: Backfill evidence stream for last 13 months for tenants that opt in to audit continuity.

Rollout and monitoring:
- Canary: Two customers on Dedicated (low-risk workloads) for 4 weeks.
- Metrics: dropped_events_rate, export_lag_seconds, migration_failure_rate, SCIM_sync_error_rate.
- Alerts: export_lag_seconds > 600s triggers P1, SCIM_sync_error_rate spike triggers P0.

Security & compliance notes:
- All event manifests signed; access to archived evidence gated by RBAC and audit logs.
- Security review required before production rollout.

Open design decisions:
- Which signing key store: platform KMS vs customer-provided HSM for Private installs. (Prefer platform KMS for hosted; customer HSM option for Private.)
- Granularity of retention policies exposed in UI (preset buckets vs arbitrary days).
